decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. PNFP001/2 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
Condition : 4 - The proposed landscaping shown on the approved drawings shall be implemented as shown and thereafter permanently maintained.
description: Installation of nine roller shutter doors in the south elevation of existing unit, provision of a ramp and consequential alterations to car parking arrangements including the removal of 29 spaces and creation of 4 spaces.
